Don't warn about website opening the product when using Office URI

By default, when user clicks an Office URI link, Internet Explorer issues a warning that a website is trying to open a program, and asks for confirmation.

This setting allows to disable the warning for Office URIs supported by the product (ms-word:, ms-excel:, ms-powerpoint:, ms-visio:, ms-access:, vnd.libreoffice.command:). Remember that this setting may be overridden by user if set in user settings.

When enabled, no warning will be issued when user clicks a supported Office URI link.
When disabled, the warning will be issued in this case.

Directory and file paths must be entered using file URL syntax, as described below.
Local drive or network drive mapped to a drive letter, such as C:
    file:///C:/path/file.ext
UNC path
    file://server/share/path/file.ext

Spaces and non-ASCII characters must be URL encoded, e.g. space must be written as %20.

The following path variables can be used:
    $(inst)  = location of installation
    $(user)  = location of user's profile
    $(username) = users login name without the domain name (since version 5.2)
    $(work)  = user's My Documents folder
    $(home)  = user's home directory
    $(temp)  = location of user's temporary files
    $(vlang) = current language code (e.g. en-US, fr, hu)

Set paths in path lists have to be separated by spaces.

Level of Macro security. Range 0 (lowest) - 3 (highest).

- Low (not recommended). All macros will be executed without confirmation. Use this setting only if you are certain that all documents that will be opened are safe.

- Low (not recommended). All macros will be executed without confirmation. Use this setting only if you are certain that all documents that will be opened are safe.
- Medium. Confirmation required before executing macros from untrusted sources.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:findlabel.description: Specifies whether column and row labels are used to refer to the column area beneath the text cell or to the row area at the right of the text cell while running a search.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:englishfu.description: Use English function names even when user interface is localized.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:recalcmod.description: Specifies whether to force a hard recalculation of formula cells after load of non-LibreOffice-generated ODF documents and/or OOXML-based Excel documents (2007 and newer).

collabora.policies.libreoffice:emptymerg.description: Specifies whether to empty the contents of the hidden cells (like Excel does).

collabora.policies.libreoffice:showmerge.description: Specifies whether the Merge Cells dialog box is shown, when some cells are not empty.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:calcprint.description: Specifies whether empty pages are printed.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:writerpri.description: Specifies whether empty pages are printed.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:allsheets.description: Specifies whether all sheets are printed instead of only the selected sheets.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:trysystem.description: Specifies if authentication using system credentials should be tried automatically for all resources that support it.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:autotexts.description: Display remainder of name as suggestion while typing

collabora.policies.libreoffice:msoformsm.description: Specifies whether Form menu should be customized for a Microsoft Office compatible workflow. The Microsoft Office compatible Form menu contains only Microsoft Office compatible form controls.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:msolockfi.description: Specifies if LibreOffice should create Microsoft Office compatible lock files next to the LibreOffice lock files when opening a file. This makes Microsoft Office to be able to read the user name from the lock file and show it for the user.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:helpexten.description: Activates the extended help in tooltips

Specifies if placeholder fields are exported to PDF.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:autotexta.description: Specifies whether a numbered or bulleted text is created automatically while typing.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:wordcompl.description: Sets the value for the minimum word length for word completion.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:tablenumb.description: Specifies whether numbers in a table are recognized or if they are saved in a text format.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:proxytype.description:
Specifies how the proxy server for network connections is selected.

None: connect directly, without a proxy.
System: use the proxy settings of the operating system.
Manual: use the proxy servers specified in the application settings.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:allowinse.description: Specifies whether unencrypted network protocols such as HTTP, SMTP and FTP may be used. If disabled, only encrypted connections are made.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:disableac.description: Specifies whether active content in documents is disabled. If enabled, embedded OLE objects are not activated and DDE links are not updated.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:disableol.description: Specifies whether the OLE Automation interface is disabled. If enabled, other applications cannot control Collabora Office through OLE Automation.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:disablepy.description: Specifies whether the Python runtime is disabled. If enabled, macros, scripts and extensions written in Python do not work.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:alloweddo.displayName: Macros allowed to run from document events
collabora.policies.libreoffice:alloweddo.description:
List of script URLs that document events (for example opening a document) are allowed to call. An entry can be a full script URL, the beginning of one, or a regular expression, for example:
    vnd.sun.star.script:Standard.Module1.Main?language=Basic&location=user
    vnd.sun.star.script:Standard.Module1
    .*location=application.*

Separate the entries with spaces. If this policy is not set, all document event URLs are allowed.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:loadexoti.displayName: Loading of rarely used file formats
collabora.policies.libreoffice:loadexoti.description: Specifies how files in rarely used legacy formats are handled when they are opened.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:tsaurls.description: List of Time Stamping Authority (TSA) servers that can be selected when signing a PDF export. Separate the URLs with spaces.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:passwordp.description:
Regular expression that a password must match when the user sets a password to protect or encrypt a document. A password that does not match is refused.

For example, the following policy requires at least eight characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit:
    ^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)[a-zA-Z\d]{8,}$

collabora.policies.libreoffice:passwordu.description: Specifies whether passwords for web connections can be saved persistently in the user profile.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:authentic.description: List of URLs that are accessed with the system credentials of the user. Separate the URLs with spaces.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:calcupdat.description: Specifies whether links to external data in spreadsheets are updated when a document is loaded.

collabora.policies.libreoffice:writerupd.description: Specifies whether links to other documents in text documents are updated when a document is loaded.
